definitions.explanation: A formal, written word for a bookshelf, used mainly for library shelving rather than shelves at home.

examples.japanese: {書架|しょか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: I return the book to the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書架|しょか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{整然|せいぜん}としている→整然とする：23003_seizentosuru⟧。
examples.english: The library's book stacks are tall and orderly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開架式|かいかしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書架|しょか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{閉架式|へいかしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書架|しょか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This library has both open-shelf and closed-shelf stacks.

notes:
{書架|しょか} is the formal, library-catalog word for bookshelf; everyday speech uses ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開架式|かいかしき}{書架|しょか}: open stacks (patrons browse directly)
- {閉架式|へいかしき}{書架|しょか}: closed stacks (staff retrieve books)
- {書架|しょか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to shelve, to arrange on the stacks
